helpdesk.try_again: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reporter.title: Report a problem
reporter.placeholder: What happened? What were you trying to do, and what did you expect to see?
reporter.images_hint: We attach a screenshot of this screen automatically. You can also paste (Ctrl+V) or add up to 5 images.
reporter.urgent_hint: Mark it only if you can't keep working until it's fixed.
reporter.sent: Thanks, we got it. We're already looking into it; you can follow the progress in My requests and we'll email you when it's solved.

suggest.title: Suggest an improvement
suggest.intro: Tell us what you need. Describe the problem you want to solve; we'll think about the best way to build it.
suggest.what_label: What would you like to be able to do?
suggest.what_placeholder: For example: export the list of work items to a spreadsheet
suggest.why_placeholder: What problem does it solve? How do you handle it today?
suggest.why_hint: At least 20 characters, so we understand the context.
suggest.how_placeholder: Any idea of how it could work is welcome.
suggest.priority_label: How important is it for you?
suggest.sent: Thanks for the suggestion. We'll analyze it and you'll be able to follow each step in My requests.

board.title: Support
board.intro: Your reports and suggestions, and where each one stands.
board.empty: You haven't sent any report or suggestion yet.
board.awaiting_authorization: {count, plural, one {# suggestion is waiting for your approval.} other {# suggestions are waiting for your approval.}}

detail.resend_hint: Still happening, or something to add? Send it to support.
detail.resent: Sent. We're looking at it again.
detail.agent_off: The suggestions agent is turned off.

admin.reject_reason_placeholder: Why it won't be built (sent to the requester)

settings.bug_agent_hint: Reports go to the fixer agent as soon as they arrive.
settings.feature_agent_hint: Analyzes new suggestions and builds the approved ones behind a flag.
settings.max_builds_hint: Maximum number of suggestions the agent builds in 7 days.

bug.derived_banner: It wasn't a defect: it became a suggestion in your name and is already being analyzed.
bug.to_workspace_banner: The fix belongs to Zil Workspace: we handed it over with our diagnosis and it continues there.
bug.answered_banner: We answered you: no change to the platform was needed.
bug.dismissed_banner: Reviewed and closed: no platform defect was found.

feature.consult_waiting: Waiting for your answer to resume the analysis
feature.on_hold: Paused: it won't move until someone resumes it.

review.ready: That's enough to work on it.
review.some_missing: A couple of details are missing
review.hint: Answer what you know: it's added to your request. If you don't know, send it anyway.

consult.title: The agent needs your answer to continue
consult.intro: It won't move until you reply. Write it in your own words: as soon as you answer, the analysis restarts on its own.
consult.placeholder: Answer here, the way you'd explain it to a teammate…
consult.relaunched: Analysis restarted: it's being redone with your answer.
consult.not_relaunched: Your answer was saved, but the analysis didn't restart on its own. An admin will pick it up.
consult.not_relaunched_off: Your answer was saved, but the analysis didn't restart: the suggestions agent is turned off.

next.analyzing: We're analyzing it. We'll let you know when it's ready for a decision.
next.needs_info_you: The agent needs your answer before it can continue.
next.needs_info: Waiting for the requester to answer the agent's questions.
next.spec_ready_you: The analysis is ready: it needs your approval.
next.spec_ready: The analysis is ready: it needs an admin's approval.
next.approved: Approved: development starts on its own as soon as a slot frees up.
next.stuck_you: Development stopped and needs your decision.
next.stuck: Development stopped: it won't move until an admin unblocks it.
next.in_review: It's done: it needs a final review before it's published.
next.queued: It passed every check: it ships in the next release.
next.merged_off: It's published: it still needs to be turned on.
next.on_hold: It's paused: it won't move until an admin resumes it.
